question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

A feeling comes over one that so much evil and misfortune have ______ the world that a little more or less does not make much difference.
solution:
The correct answer is '**shadowed**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**shadowed**" means covered with or filled with shadows or darkness and is used to describe something affected by a negative influence.
 
• In the context of the sentence, "shadowed" fits as it conveys that evil and misfortune have already affected the world significantly.
 
• The other options: "had shadowed," "shadowing," and "shadow" do not fit the context as appropriately because of incorrect tense or form.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *A feeling comes over one that so much evil and misfortune have shadowed__ the world that a little more or less does not make much difference.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Shadowed (छाया हुआ)**: means covered with dark areas or overshadowed by something negative.
 
• **Had shadowed (छाया था)**: incorrect past perfect tense usage.
 
• **Shadowing (छायांकन)**: present continuous tense, doesn't fit the sentence structure.
 
• **Shadow (छाया)**: simple present tense, incorrect tense usage.
